# Google sign-in button assets

- `google-g-light.png` is the light-background Google “G” mark extracted from Google's Sign in with Google branding bundle, as mirrored in [pixelHB](https://github.com/hugobenti/pixelHB/blob/4c2f1e7c23900ceb845752590f4caacfcd90f916/public/brand/google-g-light.png). Google and the Google “G” logo are trademarks of Google LLC; use the mark only in accordance with [Google's branding guidelines](https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines).
- `google-sans-medium-latin.woff2` is the Latin subset of Google Sans Medium. It is mirrored from [waitron](https://github.com/clintongormley/waitron/blob/b6b4f9c5153aaf52577fe2a55c72b66bdd501d45/apps/dashboard/src/assets/google-sans-medium-latin.woff2), which identifies the Google Fonts source and checksum. Copyright 2025 The Google Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans). The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt` (from [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/fc0842ce25d003e57a2fc72cd4c4a6af6175a2cc/ofl/googlesans/OFL.txt)).
